name: io.github.sharafutdinovdi/revit-model-mcp
title: Model MCP
description: Revit tools over MCP stdio. Actions are enabled by default; the workstation lock disables them.

environmentVariables.name: REVIT_MCP_HOST
environmentVariables.description: Revit host: local PowerShell, ssh:<alias>, or an http://host:port or https://host:port endpoint.

environmentVariables.name: REVIT_MCP_REDACT_PATHS
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to replace document and nested model paths with file names. Disabled by default.

environmentVariables.name: REVIT_MCP_TOOLSETS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated toolsets whose tools are listed: all, core, read, actions, documents, views-sheets, family, links, cad-mep, export, batch, code. core is always included. Limits visibility only. Default all.

environmentVariables.name: REVIT_MCP_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: HTTP bearer token from the workstation settings.json. Required only for http:// or https:// hosts; leave unset for local and SSH.
